expectations.text: Refuses to sign off tracking on the strength of settings screenshots plus a green tag-debugger result alone
expectations.evidence: "A green tag in Tag Assistant is not proof of measurement. It tells you the tag fires — it tells you nothing about whether the value, currency, or event ID are correct, or whether Google actually received and is recording it. Screenshots of settings screens are the same category of non-evidence: reviewed, not traced."

expectations.text: Requires at least one real test conversion traced end to end before any GO can issue
